regime_context: China A-shares: Banks (rank 1, durability 0.73, crowded) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, durability 0.60, crowded) are the two eligible, high-durability concentrated themes with a very narrow rotation breadth (18%). The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so the sole validated edge is absent here and all leans are low-conviction judgement calls.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Compute & Optics (rank 3, ineligible, breadth 0.059, hurst 'trend') regains breadth above 0.5 AND crosses eligibility to test a confirmed rotation handoff away from Banks; retirement condition is AI Compute staying ineligible with breadth below 0.3 through 2026-10-30.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the rank-1 eligible theme with the strongest durability (0.73) and high breadth (0.889), suggesting a broad, coherent flow concentration rather than a single-name move. Crowding (z=1.78) caps the case and argues against adding size, but does not warrant fading. Underlying justification rests on durable flow continuing, not on rank predicting return.
theses.dissent: The trend gate failed on this market's history; mean-reversion whipsaws the gate, so even a high-durability leader may reverse sharply. Crowding z=1.78 marks a late, extended move.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% before 2026-10-30

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the rank-2 eligible theme with solid durability (0.60) and a rotation challenger gap of only 0.01 to the leader, making it the closest confirmed alternative flow. It is also crowded (z=1.59), so the same cap-not-fade logic applies. Lean rests on flow concentration and durability, not a handoff claim.
theses.dissent: Narrow rotation breadth (18%) means the entire tape is being driven by two crowded names; if the macro narrative shifts (unscheduled share 0.4), both leaders can de-rate together and the best-ranked challenger offers no diversifying cushion.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% before 2026-10-30

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is eligible (rank 6) but tagged 'mean-revert' with low durability (0.46) and middling breadth (0.30). On a mean-reverting tape where the absolute trend gate has no validated edge, an eligible-but-low-durability mean-revert tag signals the theme may be near a local top for flow purposes. Avoid is a de-risk stance, not a short.
theses.dissent: Coal can catch sharp policy-driven upswings when the A-share value rotation accelerates, and eligibility means it still passed the trend filter; its lower crowding (z=0.58) leaves room for fresh inflows.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
